# OrgPath for All Clouds {.unnumbered}

::: {.callout-tip}
## Download the full document
**[orgpath-multicloud-bundle.docx](https://github.com/WhalerMike/uiao/releases/download/downloads-latest/orgpath-multicloud-bundle.docx)** — every chapter of this series concatenated into one Word document. Regenerated on every site deploy.
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="default"}
## Companion series — the UIAO OrgPath narrative
This series stands alone: it assumes only a working sketch of what OrgPath is, which the first chapter supplies. For the full story of the substrate inside the Microsoft estate — the twenty-nine-book reading sequence (plus three supplements) on facets, the codebook, dynamic groups, Administrative Units, the device planes, and the drift engine — see the **[UIAO OrgPath narrative](../orgpath-narrative/index.qmd)**.
:::

A six-chapter narrative, written in the same continuous voice as the OrgPath
series, on the question every multi-platform enterprise eventually asks: if
the organizational substrate is real, why does it only live in one vendor's
directory?

The answer the canon gives is that it doesn't have to. The fifteen-facet
model, the governed codebook, and the typed drift taxonomy make no
assumption about Microsoft. What was Microsoft-shaped was a single early
decision — that facet values are stored in the fifteen
`onPremisesExtensionAttribute` slots of an Entra directory object. The
binding-profile contract ([ADR-098](/docs/adr/adr-098-orgpath-vendor-neutral-binding-profiles.html))
retires that assumption without disturbing a single Microsoft tenant: the
slot table becomes the *reference profile*, one worked example among six,
and the same facets project onto AWS attributes and tags, Google Cloud
attributes and labels, Okta Universal Directory properties, LDAP schema
extensions, and VMware's identity, workload, and enforcement surfaces.

## Companion canon

For the normative contracts this narrative paraphrases:

- [ADR-098 — Vendor-Neutral Binding Profiles](/docs/adr/adr-098-orgpath-vendor-neutral-binding-profiles.html) — the gating decision; meaning is canonical, storage is a profile.
- [UIAO_193 — Multi-Cloud Binding Profiles](/docs/canon/UIAO_193_OrgPath_MultiCloud_Binding.html) — the specification: profile schema, six targets, Zero Trust projection.
- [Binding-profile schema reference](/reference/schemas/binding-profile.schema.html) — the executable JSON Schema the six profile documents validate against.
- [OrgPath Codebook](/customer-documents/reference-architecture/codebook.html) — the fifteen-facet Model C substrate (`UIAO_151`, `ADR-078`).
- [Drift Walk-through](/customer-documents/reference-architecture/drift-walkthrough.html) — the typed drift taxonomy (`UIAO_163`) this series extends across clouds.
